author: endersajdna
quote:
this game is a complete letdown. the characters are lame and not relatable. lucia is an annoying piece of garbage and jason is a lifeless boring rock of a character. their relationship is toxic and annoying, lucia literally ghosted jason, stole his child, and then abandoned the kid at a cafe while she failed to rob a bank and got arrested. and then were just supposed to play jason and do chores and buy flowers for this woman who is clearly a terrible person?? and we cant even cheat on her or choose to end the relationship? apart from lucia being a terrible person, jason is a total simp who just does or goes with whatever lucia wants, and i dont even understand why because shes clearly done him wrong. jason doesnt complain, he doesnt fight back, you cant choose to do it any other way without letting lucia get what she wants. hes spineless, and you are forced to be spineless playing as him. 

its like theyre a terrible couple, but the entire game is trying to force it down our throats that theyre actually a great couple and its really romantic. which really **** when the entire story seems to be solely surrounding their relationship.
